svg.title: Cold start — schema creation, seeding and index bootstrap

g.text: Cold start — schema creation, seeding and index bootstrap
Databases first — Compose gates on health, not on "started"
is why the apps do not race the databases.
own DI scope, not the root provider
against a populated volume is a no-op.
fail fast on an unknown NOSQL_DRIVER
A test deep-equals the JSON file against
the embedded constant, so drift between
them is a build failure, not a surprise.
The API base URLs were baked into the bundle
so changing a port means rebuilding this image.
